{
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Copy the rare marker pattern into every matching zero region."""
    from collections import Counter
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    marker = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == marker]
    min_r = min(r for r, c in points)
    min_c = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r - min_r, c - min_c) for r, c in points]
    max_r = max(r for r, c in shape)
    max_c = max(c for r, c in shape)
    for top in range(h - max_r):
        for left in range(w - max_c):
            if (top, left) == (min_r, min_c):
                continue
            if all(grid[top + dr][left + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[top + dr][left + dc] = marker
    return out
